set_rules.development: May be inspected and used to improve implementation.
set_rules.regression: Frozen known-failure cases; changes must not regress these protections.
set_rules.adversarial: Frozen stress cases; critical-gate pass must be 100%.
set_rules.holdout: Frozen tuning_prohibited cases. Do not use case-specific failures to tune before reporting the holdout result; fixes after a holdout failure require a new holdout version.

evaluator_order: human/external review for release-critical copy when available
anti_leakage: Do not include holdout-specific answer keys in runtime prompts.
Do not add case-specific rules solely to make a holdout pass.
Version any changed holdout set and preserve the previous result.
Regression cases may encode previously discovered failures; holdout cases may not be converted into regression until after the frozen evaluation is reported.
evaluation_note: Pairwise human/model judgments are secondary to critical factual/evidence gates; a more persuasive-sounding output fails if it violates truth/evidence constraints.
